arabic text: SAHAR QAREEB HAI JA KAR AZAN DO AKBER\nHUSSAIN HUQ PAY HAI RUN MEIN BAYAN DO AKBER
english translation text: Dawn is near—go and call the adhan, Akbar;\nproclaim in the battlefield that Hussain stands upon truth, Akbar.

arabic text:
KAHA HUSSAIN NEY SUD MARHABA JAZAKALLAH
ALI KAY POTAY HO SABIT YEH TUM NEY RUN MEIN KIYA
BUS AB YEH TAIG BHI RAKH LO NIYAM MEIN BETA
AB APNI UMMAT E JUD KO AMAAN DO AKBER
english translation text:
Hussain said: a hundred praises—well done, may Allah reward you.
You proved in battle that you are Ali's grandson.
Now place this sword back within its sheath, my son;
grant protection to this nation of your forefather, Akbar.

arabic text:
SINA'N KI ZAD PAY HAI SEENA TUMHARA SUNTA HOON
NAZAR HEE AATA NAHIN KUCH MEIN KIS TARAF JAOO'N
MUJHE PUKARO AE NOOR E NAZAR KEH MEIN POHNCHOO'N
ZAEEF BAAP KO APNA NISHAN DO AKBER

YEH HICHKION SAY JO TAAZA LAHOO UBALTA HAI
JAWAN SEENAY MEIN BURCHI KA PHAL LARAZTA HAI
TUMHARAY MARNAY SAY BABA KA DUM NIKALTA HAI
YOO'N BOORHAY BAAP KAY AAGAY NA JAAN DO AKBER

BEHEN KA AAYA HAI NAAMA ABHI MADINAY SAY
PADAR KA SAATH DO THEHRO ZARA KHUDA KAY LIYE
NIKALNI HAI YEH BURCHI TUMHARAY SEENAY SAY
KHUDA KI RAAH MEIN YEH IMTEHAN DO AKBER

SAKINA KEHTI THEE MAQTAL KI SAMT RUKH KAR KAY
RIDAEI'N CHIN GAEEIN KHEMAY BHI JAL GAYE SARAY
SAHAR SAY PEHLAY AE BHAI JO HO SAKAY TUM SAY
BAREHNA SIR PAY RIDA AA KAY TAAN DO AKBER
english translation text:
Facing the battlefield, Sakina cried:
the veils have been snatched and all the tents have burned.
Before dawn, my brother, if it is possible for you,
come and spread a veil over our bare heads, Akbar.

arabic text:
VIDA KAY AAKHRI LAMHAY BEHEN SAY WOH MAZHAR
BAWAQT E NAZA BARADAR KO KAR GAYE MUZTAR
KAHA THA SUGHRA NEY BHAI SAY JAB YEH RO RO KAR
MADINAY AAO GAY LAYNAY, ZABAN DO AKBER
english translation text:
At the final moment of farewell, O "Mazhar",
his sister had made her grieving brother promise.
Sughra had wept and asked her brother:
give me your word that you will return to Madina to take me, Akbar.
